chunks: This is a reminder for all the peoples of the world,

key_terms.لِلْعَالَمِينَ: For all the worlds / For all peoples

ai.seo_question: What is the primary purpose of the Quran as a reminder for all worlds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's role as a universal *dhikr* (reminder) intended for all creation, reflecting the Imams' function as living embodiments of this divine reminder. It highlights the continuity between revelation and the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the practical interpreters guiding humanity through the text's universal admonition.
